remarks: This residence in the Alta Vista community offers a picturesque view of the private Alta Vista Golf Course. The spacious four-bedroom, three-bathroom open floorplan is a standout feature. Upon entering, you will be captivated by the vaulted ceilings, expansive windows that flood the space with natural light and warmth, and the seamless transition into one of two living rooms adjacent to the formal dining area. As you explore further, you will discover the expansive kitchen that seamlessly connects to the second living room and fireplace, providing a stunning view of the meticulously maintained and picturesque backyard.
